The bonus damage is calculated based on the total damage of the critical strike pre-mitigation.
The bonus damage applies life steal.
If the critical strike is magic damage then Vow of the First Lands amps it directly. Otherwise, it deals it as a new instance of bonus magic damage tagged as having critically struck.
When dealt as a new instance, it can critically strike again (e.g Shadowflame), successivelly causing Vow of the First Lands to apply again on itself as an amp. (unexpected)

Passive: Yunara's basic attacks deal bonus magic damage on-hit and generate stacks of Unleash on-attack, stacking up to a cap upon which she can cast Cultivation of Spirit. Active: Yunara unleashes for a few seconds: her basic attacks gain bonus attack speed, deal additional bonus magic damage, and spread to deal physical damage to enemies near the target. The spread attack will apply life steal and on-hit effects, and can critically strike.
Passive: Yunara's basic attacks deal bonus magic damage on-hit. While this ability is inactive, her basic attacks on-attack generate a stack of Unleash for 6 seconds, increased to 2 stacks against champions. The stacks refresh on subsequent attacks, stack up to 8 times, and expire one by one every 0.5 seconds after the duration.
Passive Bonus Magic Damage:3 / 8 / 13 / 18 / 23 (+ 20% AP)
Active: Yunara unleashes for 5 seconds: gaining bonus attack speed, dealing additional bonus magic damage on-hit, and augmenting her basic attacks to have increased missile speed, a 40% lower windup time, and an uncancellable windup. Her basic attacks are also empowered to spread to each enemy near the target, dealing 30% AD physical damage.Each spread attack applies life steal and on-hit effects, with on-hit damage reduced to 30% effectiveness, and will critically strike if the triggering attack does. Spread attacks deal 250% damage against minions below 30% maximum health.
Bonus Attack Speed:20 / 30 / 40 / 50 / 60%
Active Bonus Magic Damage:3 / 8 / 13 / 18 / 23 (+ 20% AP)Combined Bonus Magic Damage:6 / 16 / 26 / 36 / 46 (+ 40% AP)
Cultivation of Spirit resets Yunara's basic attack timer. Targets do not have to be visible to be hit by the spread attacks.

Cultivation of Spirit's damage classifications:
Proc damage for the passive and active on-hit damage.
Basic damage for the spread attack damage.
The on-hit will critically strike for 0% bonus damage when the triggering attack does, causing it to be reduced by Randuin's Omen but not be amped by Vow of the First Lands. (unexpected)
Spread attacks will still deal damage even if Yunara misses her basic attack due to blind.
PENDING FOR TEST: Spread attack interaction with parrying effects ( dodge, block)
There is no limit to the number of enemies the empowered attacks can spread to.
Yunara's secondary resource bar gives various context for Cultivation of Spirit. It is visible to the player only.
While Cultivation of Spirit is not active, the bar shows her current Unleash stacks. It is colored white while below maximum stacks and yellow while at maximum stacks.
After Cultivation of Spirit is cast, the bar counts down the buff's duration.
This is also true during Transcend One's Self, which means that the bar effectively also counts down the duration of her Transcendent State.
If Yunara begins an attack windup toward the end of the active effects' duration and its launch would take place after it, the effects' duration is extended equal to the attack's windup time, once at most.
Since the buff ends right after launching Cultivation of Spirit's attack and its effects have already been determined, this allows it to both spread to nearby enemies and generate a stack of Unleash.
Each bolt from Runaan's Hurricane's Wind's Fury may trigger its own spread attack (despite the spread attacks not being an on-hit effect).
Tips & Tricks
While Cultivation of Spirit has no cooldown, the ability has a minimum downtime that is the time it takes for Yunara to generate 8 stacks.
Against champions, this downtime is 6.15 seconds at Yunara's base attack speed (0.65), 20 seconds at minimum attack speed (0.2), and 1.33 seconds at maximum attack speed (3.003).
Against non-champions, this downtime is 12.31 seconds at Yunara's base attack speed (0.65), 40 seconds at minimum attack speed (0.2), and 2.66 seconds at maximum attack speed (3.003).
These can be further decreased with effects that allow exceeding the attack speed cap or reset the attack timer.

Active: Yunara launches a spinning prayer bead that briefly slows down upon hitting an enemy. The initial hit against each enemy deals magic damage and slows the target, and the bead continually deals magic damage to nearby enemies. Upon reaching maximum range, the bead expands and lingers briefly.
Active: Yunara launches a spinning prayer bead in the target direction that briefly grants sight of its surroundings as it travels. The bead slows down significantly while colliding with an enemy, lingering as it travels and resetting its remaining duration; upon reaching maximum range, it will expand and linger in place for 1 second regardless of enemies hit.The initial hit against each enemy before the bead's expansion deals magic damage and slows them by 99% decaying over 1.5 seconds. While lingering, the bead deals 15% of the impact damage as magic damage to nearby enemies every 0.25 seconds.
Initial Magic Damage:55 / 95 / 135 / 175 / 215 (+ 85% bonus AD) (+ 50% AP)
Linger Magic Damage per Tick:8.25 / 14.25 / 20.25 / 26.25 / 32.25 (+ 12.75% bonus AD) (+ 7.5% AP)
Total Expanded Damage:33 / 57 / 81 / 105 / 129 (+ 51% bonus AD) (+ 30% AP)
Arc of Judgment deals 50% / 75% / 100% (based on level) damage against minions and executes them if they would be killed by 6 more damage instances from the linger effect.

Arc of Ruin grants sight of its surroundings during the cast time and for 0.3 seconds afterwards.
This ability will cast from wherever the caster is at the end of the cast time.
The cooldown of Arc of Ruin can be reduced by any item or rune that reduces ultimate cooldown.

COST:
100 Mana
COOLDOWN:
100 / 90 / 80
CAST TIME:

Passive: Arc of Ruin's damage and Untouchable Shadow's dash speed are increased. Active: Yunara enters Transcendent State for some time. Transcendent State: Yunara gains Cultivation of Spirit's active effect, Arc of Judgment and Kanmei's Steps are upgraded into Arc of Ruin and Untouchable Shadow. Kanmei's Steps' and Arc of Judgment's cooldowns are reset and reduced, respectively, upon both entering and exiting the state.
Passive: Arc of Ruin's base damage and Untouchable Shadow's dash speed scale with Transcend One's Self's rank.
Arc of Ruin Base Damage:160 / 320 / 480
Untouchable Shadow Dash Speed:1350 / 1500 / 1650
Active: Yunara enters Transcendent State for 15 seconds, during which each of her basic abilities is empowered:
Cultivation of Spirit: Automatically becomes active at no cost, with the duration increased to Transcendent State's.
Arc of Judgment: Upgraded into Arc of Ruin, which has no cost and has its remaining cooldown reduced by 80% upon both entering and exiting the state.
Kanmei's Steps: Upgraded into Untouchable Shadow, which has no cost and has its cooldown reset upon both entering and exiting the state.
"Relentless fortitude!"
